blocks.heading: 1. Basic Laws of Probability
bullets: Addition Rule: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B)
If events are mutually exclusive: P(A ∩ B) = 0 ⇒ P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B)
Conditional Probability: P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B) (where P(B) > 0)
Independent Events: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) · P(B) ⇒ P(A|B) = P(A)

blocks.heading: 2. Bayes' Theorem
blocks.intro: Used to calculate posterior probability when partition events E₁, E₂...Eₙ are given:
bullets: P(Eᵢ|A) = [ P(Eᵢ) · P(A|Eᵢ) ] / [ Σ[j=1 to n] P(Eⱼ) · P(A|Eⱼ) ]

blocks.heading: 3. Statistics & Measures of Central Tendency
bullets: Median : Middle value. If n is odd: ((n+1)/2)th term. If n is even: Mean of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

blocks.heading: 4. Measures of Dispersion
bullets: Variance (σ²) : σ² = Σ(xᵢ - x̄)² / n = (Σ xᵢ² / n) - (x̄)²
Coefficient of Variation (CV) : CV = (σ / x̄) * 100 (measures relative consistency).
